title: Starter Timeline
subtitle: Template starter guidance
body: First 10 minutes: Read the Ashfall install notes. Confirm the official profile module list. Open the Ashfall-safe starter TutorialCore card. First 30 minutes: Review known issues and server notes. Track the first official-profile HoloMap marker. Complete the Ashfall profile validation mission. Run diagnostics before publishing an export. First 2 hours: Validate client and server export profiles. Review official Index and Terminal content registration. Keep Ashfall-specific content inside the official profile namespace.
